body:
IMPLEMENTATION HANDOFF — pasteable end-to-end code, exact output, and plot data for the owner gate.

The earlier console result remains current: between the run base `60218ff` and current main `df107db`, `git diff --name-only 60218ff..HEAD -- align recall fixtures embed-bench core story` is empty.

The docs can publish this public-API path now:

```scala
import storymodel4s.align.*
import storymodel4s.align.bridge.StorySourceView
import storymodel4s.core.StorySource
import storymodel4s.fixtures.wog.{WarOfTheGhostsExpectations, WarOfTheGhostsModel}
import storymodel4s.recall.RecallSegmenter

val view = StorySourceView.validated(WarOfTheGhostsModel.model)

val recallText =
  WarOfTheGhostsExpectations.recallParaphrases.map(_.text).mkString(" ")
val transcript =
  StorySource
    .fromText(recallText, Some("War of the Ghosts recall"))
    .fold(error => throw new IllegalArgumentException(error.message), identity)
val recall = RecallSegmenter.segment(transcript)

val semantic = SemanticDistance.lexicalJaccard
val candidates =
  CandidateGenerator(semantic).generate(recall.ordered, view)
val result =
  GraphHsmm
    .infer(recall, view, candidates, DefaultLocalCostModel(semantic = semantic))
    .fold(error => throw new IllegalStateException(error.message), identity)
val signature =
  RecallSignature
    .compute(result, recall, view)
    .fold(error => throw new IllegalStateException(error.message), identity)

println(s"units: ${recall.size}")
println("Viterbi: " + result.viterbi.map(_.key).mkString(" -> "))
println(f"uniform coverage: ${signature.uniformCoverage}%.4f")
println("fidelity: " + signature.fidelityMass.render)
println("specificity: " + signature.specificityMass.render)
println("compression: " + signature.compression.render)
println("discourse chronology: " + signature.discourseChronology.render)
println("world chronology: " + signature.worldChronology.render)
println("causal preservation: " + signature.causalPreservation.render)
println(signature.externalMass.render)
println("backward: " + signature.backwardMass.map(_.render).getOrElse("n/a"))

val posteriorPlotRows =
  result.posterior.rows.flatMap { row =>
    row.mass.toVector.sortBy(_._1.key).map { case (state, mass) =>
      (row.unit.value, state.key, mass)
    }
  }
```

Exact observed output from that same run:

```text
units: 6
Viterbi: ext:Intrusion -> ext:Intrusion -> ext:Intrusion ->
         ext:Intrusion -> ext:Intrusion -> ext:Intrusion
uniform coverage: 0.0115
fidelity: 0.5588 (support 1.0000 = 0.8331/0.8331)
specificity: 0.3086 (support 0.1389 = 0.8331/6.0000)
compression: 0.0803 (support 0.1389 = 0.8331/6.0000)
discourse chronology: 0.4973 (support 0.0045 = 0.0225/5.0000)
world chronology: 0.4519 (support 0.0017 = 0.0083/5.0000)
causal preservation: n/a (support 0.0000 = 0.0000/9.0000)
external(attributed)=0.8611 unranked=0.0000 ranked=1.0000
backward: 0.0023 (over 5/5 comparable steps)
```

EXPLANATION THE PAGE OWES:

- Six units come from five paraphrases because the production segmenter splits one statement.
- `ext:Intrusion` is a modeled destination, not an exception and not unranked failure.
- The aligner ranked every unit, hence unranked 0 and ranked 1.
- The weak lexical channel still assigns most mass outside the source. This is evidence that mechanics run, not evidence of useful semantic accuracy.
- Fidelity rests on only 0.8331 anchored mass. Specificity and compression have 13.89 percent support. Chronology values have effectively negligible support. They must not be narrated as stable participant traits.
- Causal preservation is undefined, not zero, because none of nine eligible causal edges had conditioning support.

THREE STATIC PLOTS, generated from the same objects:

1. POSTERIOR HEATMAP: rows are the six recall units; columns are source anchors plus each named external state; cell area or labelled intensity is posterior mass. Collapse faithful/distorted only if both remain separately identified in labels or a second glyph. Never silently top-k: if columns are grouped, carry the grouped mass as an explicit remainder.
2. VITERBI TRAJECTORY: x is recall order; y is source discourse order with distinct labelled external lanes. This run visibly stays on the Intrusion lane. That is the honest picture.
3. SIGNATURE AND SUPPORT: for each MassRatio, draw value and support as two separate geometric bars with numeric labels. `causal = n/a; support 0/9` gets an empty/undefined value slot, not a zero-height value bar. Colour cannot be the only distinction.

The next stronger tutorial can swap `lexicalJaccard` for a measured embedding channel while keeping every other line and every plot definition unchanged. That is how the docs demonstrate architecture rather than one lucky output.
